slug: 2025-06-10 Guinea-Bissau deploys efforts to digitize birth registration, national ID systems

facts.fact: Guinea-Bissau's civil registration is being digitized through the new Integrated System of Citizen Registers and Statistics (SIREC), with registration on the platform begun about three months before the interview and civil-registry officers trained on enrolment kits, per Raul Gomes of the Ministry of Justice.

systems.system: SIREC (Integrated System of Citizen Registers and Statistics)
